content.text:
No. Per **"Re-running failed jobs in a workflow"** (content/actions/how-tos/manage-workflow-runs/re-run-workflows-and-jobs.md), "Re-run failed jobs" only re-runs jobs that failed — there's no option to force a specific step or job to always re-run even if it succeeded. The docs don't mention any per-step override for this behavior.

Workaround: use **"Re-running a specific job in a workflow"** (same file) to manually re-run your setup job alongside the failed test job via `gh run rerun --job <job-id>`, or use **"Re-running all the jobs in a workflow"** to re-run the entire workflow.
